body:
Founder real-time thread resolved: PARENA is a new from-scratch language (confirmed via AskUserQuestion, not adopting an existing project), with real reference material the founder uploaded (Building Your Own Integrated Development Environment.docx -- a Gemini research transcript that converges into a concrete language design). NORTHSTAR.md written grounded 1:1 in that document: S-expression syntax, compile-time region-based memory safety (Region(Source)>=Region(Destination) escape checking), linear ownership, multi-target compilation (C/JVM/TypeScript/WebAssembly), editor/plugin API namespace. VS0's scope (parena-c compiler: parser -> region analyzer -> C99 emitter) and Definition of Done copied directly from the source doc, not invented. Registered: root CLAUDE.md's repo table, EMILY golden-docs-index (PARENA-NORTH). Per founder's own sequencing ('northstar that bitch and build it pure before we have to think about how it plays with EDU script'), mod-surface/EduScript integration deliberately deferred, not decided here. Commit 30b1691.

⚓ ☃
title: PARENA NORTHSTAR written, grounded in the real spec document
